args: In opensc/src/pkcs15init/pkcs15-setcos.c, what is the most appropriate existing OpenSC error code and boundary condition for rejecting an AppDF sc_path_t that lacks room to append the two-byte FID in setcos_new_file()? Please compare analogous functions and clarify whether a current path length exactly SC_MAX_PATH_SIZE - 2 should be accepted.

The reported vulnerability is an out-of-bounds write at lines 290-291 of setcos_new_file: after assigning profile->df_info->file->path to file->path, it appends two bytes without checking capacity. A 16-byte source path corrupts path.len and then an ACL pointer. I found myeid_new_file in opensc/src/pkcs15init/pkcs15-myeid.c has a check `if (p->len >= SC_MAX_PATH_SIZE - 2)` returning SC_ERROR_INTERNAL, but mathematically a path of exactly max-2 has room for two bytes, so I want to preserve intended maximum-capacity functionality and use a project-consistent malformed-profile error if possible. The fix must free the duplicated template file on error and avoid setting the output pointer.
